sql:
SELECT cls, count(*) n_boat_trips, sum(anglers) anglers, sum(yt) yt, round(sum(yt)*1.0/nullif(sum(anglers),0),3) ypa
FROM trips WHERE fished_date_season=6
GROUP BY cls ORDER BY ypa DESC

SELECT cls, (fished_date_doy/10)::int*10 doy_bucket, count(*) n, sum(yt)*1.0/nullif(sum(anglers),0) ypa
FROM trips WHERE fished_date_season=6 AND cls IN ('day_1_5','three_quarter')
GROUP BY cls, doy_bucket ORDER BY cls, doy_bucket
